themes.name: Fit & Size Uncertainty
themes.definition: Shoppers doubt whether an item will fit them because size charts are unclear or inconsistent. This uncertainty makes them hesitant to buy a saved item.
includes: I don't know if this size will fit me
I can't find a fit guide
excludes: I want to buy it later

themes.name: Product Authenticity & Quality
themes.definition: Shoppers question if the product is genuine or made of good material. Lack of confidence in authenticity or quality stops them from purchasing.

themes.name: Platform Trust & Security
themes.definition: Shoppers worry about fraud, data privacy, or platform security when buying. This perceived risk creates a psychological barrier to buying saved items.
excludes: I need to check return policy

themes.name: Product Info & Visual Gaps
themes.definition: Missing or unclear images, specs, or details prevent shoppers from visualizing or evaluating the item. This void blocks purchase confidence.

themes.name: Social Proof Scarcity
themes.definition: When reviews, ratings, or user photos are missing or sparse, shoppers lack confidence in fit, quality, or style. The absence of peer validation reduces perceived reliability.

themes.name: Wishlist Usability Friction
themes.definition: Issues that make saving, locating, or moving items from the wishlist difficult. They cause users to forget or ignore saved items.
includes: No add to cart from wishlist

themes.name: Checkout & Payment Friction
themes.definition: Problems during the final purchase step, such as payment failures or confusing checkout flow, stop users from completing a transaction.

themes.name: Delivery & Stock Uncertainty
themes.definition: Uncertainty about shipping windows, item availability, or delivery reliability makes users hesitant to commit to a purchase.

themes.name: Return & Exchange Friction
themes.definition: Perceived complexity, cost, or time required to return or exchange an item deters shoppers from committing to a purchase.

themes.name: Price Transparency & Value
themes.definition: Unexpected price changes, hidden fees, or perceived high price relative to value erode confidence and cause abandonment.

themes.name: Platform Usability & Performance
themes.definition: Interface glitches, slow loading, or app crashes make it hard to move from saved to purchase. They increase effort and fear of failure.

themes.name: Customer Support Friction
themes.definition: Slow, unhelpful, or inaccessible support leaves doubts unresolved, discouraging finalization of a wishlist purchase.
